physical_description.build: Lean and angular with corded muscle density — built for precision work rather than raw strength. Shoulders slightly narrower than hips, creating an understated silhouette.

physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close on sides, slightly longer on top — styled back with subtle texture. Low maintenance, high function.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle golden undertones from mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, defined jawline. Skin is clear and well-maintained but not pampered — the complexion of someone who prioritizes function over aesthetics. Minimal facial hair.
distinguishing_marks: Thin surgical scar along the left temple, barely visible unless light hits it directly
Small burn mark on the inner right wrist — roughly 2cm diameter, old and faded silver
Faint tattoo on the back of the neck: geometric circuit pattern in matte black, barely visible under their typical collar line
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Operates on the assumption that visible chrome signals desperation or ego.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight distributed evenly, shoulders relaxed. Eyes constantly scanning. Handshakes are firm but brief. Speech is measured; they listen more than they talk.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear. Prefers neutral colors: charcoal, black, muted gray. Typical outfit: reinforced cargo pants with multiple hidden pockets, fitted synthweave turtleneck or unmarked tech jacket. Worn-in leather boots with non-slip soles. Minimal branding. A single piece of jewelry — a thin braided bracelet in matte gunmetal, possibly containing subcutaneous tech interface. Dressing room aesthetic: function first, invisibility second.
